description: Move nodes on the canvas, by `delta`, or so the first id lands at `to` (the rest keep their offsets). Pass exactly one of the two. One undo step. A diagram regenerated from text lays its nodes out again.

delta.description: Offset added to every node, in pixels.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

ids.description: Node ids to move together (get_document lists them).

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

to.description: Where the first id goes, in the x/y get_document reports for it (a node inside a frame counts from the frame).

name: move
title: Move shapes
